第一千零九十五章 心魔并非什么大事（第1页）
心魔并非什么大事（心魔并非什么大事（第22页）楚祗波、苗喵同时拱手道，“天下妖族是一家，道友客气了。”“走，先将身份令牌办了，然后到金光城内转转。”在穷奇殿这行人中，鼠标并非最年长者，其言行举止却是最具权威性的，只因其是穷奇殿指定的第一护道人。待鼠标等远去后，小金毛是看向楚祗波道，“沙皮狗，你觉得鼠标如何？”楚祗波毫不避讳道，“不是因为有心魔的存在，定会是我妖族至强者之一。”小金毛赞同道，“我也是这么认为的。”楚祗波好奇道，“武金长老，你先前不还是对城主大人说，来自穷奇殿的这些妖族道友非常不好相处吗？怎么又改变主意了？”苗喵附和道，“怕不是因为同类相亲相近，有些宗门长老想要徇私枉法了。”思量多时，小金毛果断道，“道心存在裂痕，还能够成为穷奇大陆这些小辈的护道人，在听了裂天谷中那位大人的建议后，直奔苍源域。或许在尔等看来，选择帮助鼠标将心魔化解掉，是我小金毛在徇私枉法，但我小金毛却认为，能够借此机会将这些来自穷奇殿的这群小辈吸收掉，何尝不算是我苍源域平白多出了一大助力。”楚祗波赞同道，“有道理。”苗喵改口道，“这样吧？事关穷奇殿这批小辈身份令牌分发一事由我和波哥负责，向少主报备一事，由武金长老负责。”小金毛立马高兴道，“那便有劳两位圣兽大人了。”……“少主？少……少主？”真到当面向武书上报以鼠标为首的穷奇殿一行小辈的事情时，小金毛的心里还是非常忐忑的。而令小金毛感到不可思议的是，其越想平复心情，反倒越紧张。“出来吧？少主都等你半天了。”青年蜚语的声音突然在小金毛耳边响起，小金毛也是一惊。“都在鬼风城后院地下嘀咕半天了，本王的耳朵都要被你练习的那几句话磨出老茧了。也不知我们的金毛老祖怎么了？在少主面前连话都说不好了。”被青年蜚语这么一调侃，小金毛破土而出道，“见过少主，见过太上长老。”院落内，灯火通明，武书笑道，“小金毛长老，坐。”小金毛一边坐下一边紧张道，“少主，我刚刚说的那些话，你不会都听到了吧？”武书摇头笑道，“你是说哪一句？”见小金毛一脸尴尬，武书赞赏道，“近来，东云帝国、东土帝国、裂天谷皆是将一部分领地划归给我苍源域，其中有几座城池的城主肯定是要进行调整的。而即便鼠标等不出现，苍源域也会举行一场盛会。然后，从此次盛会中挑选出一部分优秀弟子前往这些城池担任重要职务。正当用人之际，鼠标等愿意与我苍源域合作，让本少主再次进入十里道台与众同辈论道，本少主肯定是非常愿意的。”小金毛高兴道，“真的吗？”武书笑道，“小金毛长老，有件事情，你说的没错，在本少主面前，心魔并非什么大事情。”

Chapter 1095: Inner demons are not a big deal (page 1)
Inner demons are not a big deal (Inner demons are not a big deal (page 22)) Chu Zhibo and Miao Miao raised their hands at the same time and said, "The demon clan in the world is one family. Fellow Taoist, please be polite." "Let's get the identity token first, and then we'll arrive. Walking around Jinguang City. "Among the people in Qiongqi Palace, Mouse is not the eldest, but his words and deeds are the most authoritative, just because he is the first guardian designated by Qiongqi Palace. After Mouse and others left, Xiao Jin Mao Zhi looked at Chu Zhibo and said, "Shar Pei, what do you think of the mouse?" Chu Zhibo said without hesitation, "If it weren't for the existence of inner demons, he would definitely be one of the strongest members of our demon clan." Little Golden Retriever agreed, "I think so too." Chu Zhibo asked curiously, "Elder Wu Jin, didn't you tell the city lord before that these demon clan Taoists from Qiongqi Palace are very difficult to get along with? Why did you change your mind again?" Miao agreed, "I'm afraid it's not because of the close relationship between the same kind, but some elders of the sect want to bend the law for personal gain." After thinking for a long time, the little golden retriever said decisively, "There are cracks in the Taoist heart, and they can still become juniors like Qiongqi Continent." The protector, after listening to the advice of the adult in the Split Sky Valley, went straight to the Cangyuan Territory. Perhaps in your opinion, my little golden retriever was bending the law for personal gain by choosing to help the mouse resolve his inner demons, but I, the little golden retriever, recognized it. Because being able to take this opportunity to absorb these juniors from Qiongqi Palace is not a big help to us." Chu Zhibo agreed, "That makes sense." Miao Miao changed his words, "Isn't that right? Brother Bo and I will be responsible for reporting the matter to the young master." Xiao Jinmao immediately said happily, "Then it's up to the two holy beast masters. "..."Young Master? Young...Young Master?" When he reported the matter of the juniors from Qiongqi Palace to Wu Shu, he felt very uneasy. This made him feel unbelievable. What's more, the more he tried to calm down, the more nervous he became. "Come out, please? The young master has been waiting for you for a long time." The young man's gossiping voice suddenly sounded in the little golden hair's ears, and the little golden hair was also surprised. "They are all behind Ghost Wind City." The people in the courtyard have been muttering for a long time, and my ears are calloused by the few words you practiced. I wonder what happened to our golden-haired ancestor? He can't even speak in front of the young master." The young man said this. After teasing, Little Golden Retriever burst out of the ground and said, "I have met the young master, I have met the Supreme Elder." In the courtyard, the lights were brightly lit, Wu Shu smiled and said, "Elder Little Golden Retriever, sit down." Little Golden Retriever said nervously as he sat down, "Young Master Lord, you didn't hear everything I just said?" Wu Shu shook his head and said with a smile, "Which one did you say?" Seeing the embarrassment on Xiao Jinmao's face, Wu Shu said in appreciation, "Recently, Dongyun Empire, Dongtu Empire, and Split Sky Valley have all assigned part of their territories to me, and the city lords of several of them must make adjustments. And even if the mouse does not appear, there will be a grand meeting in Cangyuan Territory from now on. A number of outstanding disciples were selected from this grand meeting to take up important positions in these cities. At the time of recruitment, Mouse and others are willing to cooperate with me in the Shili Dao Platform to discuss Taoism with my peers. I am definitely very willing." Little Jinmao said happily, "Really?" Wu Shu said with a smile, "Little Jinmao, you are right about one thing. In front of me, inner demons are not a big deal."
